title: Rebound War Live Shots
description: A shooter takes live shots from the elbow while two players battle for position to secure the rebound off the miss, make, or long bounce.

content.objective: Battle for real rebounding position on every live shot attempt, not just a toss-up drill.
content.setup: A shooter stands at the elbow; two other players stand ready near the lane for the rebound battle.
instructions: The shooter takes a live shot from the elbow.
Both rebounders fight for a box-out position the instant the shot is released.
Whoever secures the rebound scores a point for their side; the other resets quickly.
Rotate the shooter in after every three attempts.
coachingPoints: Locate your player the instant the shot goes up, before watching the ball.
Use the body to seal position, not the hands to grab.
Go get the ball with two hands once boxed out successfully.
commonMistakes: Watching the shot instead of immediately finding a body to box out.
Reaching around the opponent instead of sealing with the body.
Reaching for the ball with one hand instead of securing it with two.
content.safety: Keep contact to boxing out with the body — no pushing with the hands or grabbing.
